mechanism_claims.claim_text: PgD5 treatment causes membrane permeabilization in tested fungi and S. cerevisiae as shown by SYTOX Green uptake; this supports membrane-permeability disruption as a direct mechanism class.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: PgD5 shows non-morphogenic antifungal activity: the paper reports no increased hyphal branching or morphologically altered hyphae while hyphal elongation is strongly inhibited.
